mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.14% is historically low, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that may lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% AND industrial production falls below 95.0, it signals a dual stress in the labor market and manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 AND INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime, when housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600 thousand units, it signals improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 600 and the regime is post-crisis recovery, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current non-farm payrolls level of 132,989 thousand is above the 2009 low, signaling a recovering labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS >= 130,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current quarterly GDP level of 13,502.4 billion of chained 2017 dollars is above the 2009 trough, signaling a recovering economy that supports positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current housing starts level of 654.0 thousand units is above the 2009 low, signaling improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
